code_observations: Verified by run, not a bug in the deposited one-session pipeline: functions.R ensemble_modz (lines 240, 256, 274, 290) assigns the weights column by reference inside the data= argument and passes weights=X_s$weights. When X_s is a data.table without column over-allocation (e.g. loaded with readRDS), the 'RE pop weights' lmer fit silently uses the stale weights column (1) and equals the unweighted fit. In my first staged run this changed Table A2.4 and the Hausman p row of Table A2.3 but not the FE targets. With setalloccol(X_s), which restores the state line 58 produces in one session, Tables A2.3 and A2.4 match the deposited .tex exactly (outputs/diff_tabA2_*.txt, outputs/s1b_run1_noalloc/, scripts/diag_alloc_test.R).
Unverified observation: functions.R line 102 (tlagz) refers to X_ instead of its argument data; tlagz is defined but never called in run2_main.R, so no output depends on it.
Code read: run2_main.R lines 43-157 and 1310-1408, functions.R lines 1-95 and 228-336 (preprocez, phtest_felm, ensemble_modz, betamat). No real bug found in the target blocks.
env_fixes: diffs/functions_R_mc_cores.diff: mc.cores=0.5 on 2 CPUs is rejected by mclapply; wrapped in max(1, ...) as PREREG allows
